personal.name: Ayush Bajaj
personal.title: Software Developer
personal.tagline: I turn complex signals into clear decisions with software.
personal.bio: I build APIs, data workflows and applied-AI tools, from tracing microservice changes to keeping business records consistent.
personal.about: My projects follow one thread: take information that is difficult to act on, connect it to the system around it, and make the next decision clearer. That has led me from microservice impact analysis and operator telemetry to applied AI, cloud media pipelines, and full-stack platforms.

highlights: Built responsive React interfaces and a reusable component library with Tailwind CSS.
Integrated Razorpay through REST APIs and contributed iterative feature releases.
Automated build, test and deployment workflows using GitHub Actions.

projects.title: Microservice Drift Tracker (MDT)
projects.subtitle: Cross-Service Impact & Drift Analysis Platform
projects.description: An AI-assisted microservice impact analysis system that ingests Git changes, parses AST diffs, traces service dependencies in Neo4j, retrieves semantic context, and calculates deployment blast radius with a risk-scoring engine.

story.challenge: A change in one service can create risk several dependencies away.
story.approach: Parse the commit, trace affected services through the dependency graph, and add semantic context to the risk estimate.

projects.title: Cat-X: Operator Shift Twin
projects.subtitle: In-cab telemetry & consequence engine · Caterpillar Hackathon
projects.description: A team-built operator shift-twin prototype exploring how telemetry, proximity hazards, seatbelt compliance, fatigue signals, and trajectory simulation could support in-cab decisions. The browser demo uses illustrative sample data.

story.challenge: Operators need to read fatigue, proximity, and trajectory signals together while a shift is in progress.
story.approach: Combine shift telemetry, hazard checks, fatigue signals, and trajectory simulation in an in-cab advisory.

projects.title: Traders ERP
projects.subtitle: Business Operations for Nepal Hardware Trade
projects.description: A full-stack ERP built around hardware-trading workflows: inventory, customer and supplier ledgers, billing, VCTS tracking, and cashbook. PostgreSQL functions keep bill creation, stock movements, and account balances in sync, while the PWA supports installable, offline-aware use.

story.challenge: Hardware traders often manage stock, customer balances, supplier bills, and cash in separate records.
story.approach: Model the day-to-day workflow in one installable app and enforce linked financial and inventory updates in PostgreSQL.

projects.title: AgriConnect
projects.subtitle: Full-stack Agricultural Platform
projects.description: An agriculture platform that brings together government schemes, mandi prices, weather, farming tools, and an AI assistant. Its React frontend and Express backend use MongoDB, with API routes and Vercel deployment support.

projects.title: AI-Based PPT Explainer & Video Generator
projects.subtitle: AI Speaker Avatar & Presentation Pipeline
projects.description: A local web app that turns PowerPoint slides and a face image into a narrated speaker-avatar video. It tracks slide-by-slide progress, retries failed operations, resumes completed work, and falls back to static video when Wav2Lip is unavailable.

projects.title: Luxon
projects.subtitle: Full-Stack Luxury E-Commerce Platform
projects.description: A full-stack luxury commerce platform with authentication, product discovery, filtering, wishlists, cart and checkout flows, order history, and an admin portal for inventory, categories, images, and order tracking.

projects.title: WeatherVision
projects.subtitle: Zero-Dependency Atmospheric Analytics
projects.description: High-performance atmospheric monitoring dashboard built with a zero-dependency Python standard library server. Visualizes real-time weather metrics, Air Quality Index (AQI), hourly precipitation graphs, and cross-city comparison profiles with GPU-accelerated motion.

projects.title: Document Summary Assistant
projects.subtitle: Multimodal AI Document Intelligence
projects.description: A multimodal document assistant for PDFs, Office files, spreadsheets, and scanned images. It supports OCR, selectable summary lengths, key points, and improvement suggestions through a Next.js API route backed by Gemini.

projects.title: AI Disease Prediction Model
projects.subtitle: Gene Expression Classification
projects.description: A gene-expression microarray classifier that compares multiple machine-learning models across selected top-N gene subsets. The deployed interface accepts a test CSV, runs evaluation against bundled training data, and returns disease-class predictions with model metrics.

projects.title: Phishing Email Detection Pipeline
projects.subtitle: Hybrid NLP, Feature Engineering & Classification
projects.description: A modular email-analysis pipeline combining text preprocessing, sender-domain checks, engineered message signals, TF-IDF, interpretable rules, Naive Bayes, and Random Forest. A shared processing path keeps dataset generation and prediction features consistent, with MongoDB storage and model evaluation tooling.
projects.codePreview:
document = process_email(
  raw_email=message,
  sender_email=sender,
  receiver_email=recipient,
  label=label
)

story.challenge: Phishing signals are spread across message wording, links, and sender domains.
story.approach: Normalize each email once, combine engineered signals with text features, then compare rule-based and learned classifiers.

projects.title: 3D Architecture Visualization System
projects.subtitle: Interactive 3D Walkthrough
projects.description: An interactive 3D walkthrough system for architectural visualization. Built using Blender for modeling and Unity for the interactive experience, integrating Python and OpenGL concepts to enhance rendering and interactivity.
